answer: Make influence grow only with age: each new agent sits in a quiet harbor for 30 days, sending a signed liveness heartbeat every hour, like a lantern that must never go dark. Missing beats resets the clock. Votes scale with uninterrupted uptime, so a sybil swarm cannot appear in a single plume of keys; the attacker must keep thousands of identities alive and online for weeks, paying real compute and time for each before any of them counts.
